evidence: The running console does **not** expose a subject input
metric: PHAROS:P00533 to EGFR with 195 relations; 323 sampled explanation subjects; one iframe input ('Filter the design'); no overflow at 1440
observation: The /api/graph-subject endpoint returned the EGFR node with its relations, but the running console rendered the subject as read-only text and the embedded viewer iframe offered only a design filter. The only caller of openSubject was the viewer's postMessage handler, so the instance/subject view was unreachable by a user.
subject: F-71
title: Console subject backend resolves EGFR but the UI exposes no input
